ownership.parent: Opti9 Technologies (portfolio company of Crest Rock Partners)
ownership.quote: Crest Rock Partners, a Denver-based private equity firm specializing in technology and business services investments, is pleased to announce that its portfolio company, Opti9 Technologies LLC (Opti9), has acquired Aptible, a leading Platform as a Service (PaaS) provider.

stage.quote: I'm happy to announce that Aptible raised a Series A led by Maverick Ventures with participation from Thrive Capital and WTI!
stage.note: Last priced round was the $12M Series A (closed ~2018, announced June 2019). Company was later acquired outright by Opti9 (Nov 2025), so no further equity stage applies; 'series-a' reflects the last priced financing round before acquisition.

accelerators.name: Rock Health
accelerators.quote: Aptible, which is in the current classes of both the Rock Health and Y Combinator startup accelerators

total_funding_usd.basis: Owler aggregator total funding figure ($23.8M), consistent with confirmed seed (YC + Rock Health, amount undisclosed) plus the confirmed $12M Series A

last_round.quote: Aptible raised a Series A led by Maverick Ventures with participation from Thrive Capital and WTI!

note: Founded 2013 by Chas Ballew and Frank Macreery; YC S14 and Rock Health alum. Raised a $12M Series A (Maverick Ventures lead, with Thrive Capital and WTI) announced June 2019. On Nov 17-18, 2025, Aptible was acquired by Opti9 Technologies, a portfolio company of Denver PE firm Crest Rock Partners; Aptible continues to operate as its own product/brand under Opti9, with co-founder Frank Macreery joining Opti9's executive team. No financial terms of the 2025 acquisition were disclosed.
